title: Commutative algebras in Drinfeld categories of abelian Lie algebras.
abstract: We describe (braided-)commutative algebras with non-degenerate multiplicative form in certain braided monoidal categories, corresponding to abelian metric Lie algebras (so-called Drinfeld categories). We also describe local modules over these algebras and classify commutative algebras with finite number of simple local modules.

cards.snippet: The category $\cC_A^{loc}$ is a full monoidal subcategory of ${_A}{\cC}$. Moreover, the braiding in $\cC$ induces a braiding in ${_A}{\cC}^{loc}$.
